mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) may potentiate trazodone's CNS depressant effects and both drugs can cause ototoxicity; amikacin is also nephrotoxic which may affect trazodone clearance in renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function regularly, assess for ototoxicity and excessive sedation; use lowest effective trazodone dose and ensure adequate hydration during amikacin therapy.
